question: My jacket wets out quickly in rain. Does that mean the waterproof membrane is leaking?
gt_answer: Not necessarily. Rab explains that worn DWR can make the face fabric wet out: water soaks into the surface instead of beading and rolling off. This evidence describes DWR wetting-out, but does not by itself establish membrane leakage.
